method.confidence_scope: conditional propagation of frozen source-specific diagonal 58-feature variance, not total CI or prediction interval
method.marginal_vs_simultaneous: 95% marginal and Bonferroni simultaneous box (95% lower bound); historical 99.73% gates not modified
method.long_label_correction: all six legacy long pairs executed FAST 600/120, not LONG 1800/600
method.covariance_limitation: frozen diagonal approximation; historical state transfer, source temperature, between-session, common-reference and interpolation effects not included
